    <div xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml"><p class="res-header-id"><b>Generated Narrative: StructureMap SMNGSReport</b></p><a name="SMNGSReport"> </a><a name="hcSMNGSReport"> </a><pre class="fml">
<b>map</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span>https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/StructureMap/sm-ngs-report<span style="color: navy">&quot; = &quot;</span>SMNGSReport<span style="color: navy">&quot;

</span><b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="StructureDefinition-dnpm-lm-patient-record.html" title="DNPM Patient Record">https://dnpm-dip.net/fhir/StructureDefinition/dnpm-lm-patient-record</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>DNPMPatientRecord <b>as </b><b>source</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/bundle.html" title="Bundle">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Bundle</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Bundle <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/diagnosticreport.html" title="DiagnosticReport">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/DiagnosticReport</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>DiagnosticReport <b>as </b><b>produced</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/observation.html" title="Observation">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Observation</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Observation <b>as </b><b>produced</b>

<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">---------------------------------------------------------------------------</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Root group: iterate over all ngsReports in the PatientRecord</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">---------------------------------------------------------------------------</span>
<b>group </b>NGSReports<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">src</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>DNPMPatientRecord, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Bundle<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>bundle.type = <span style="color: blue">'collection'</span> <i>&quot;bundleType&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  src.ngsReports<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">ngs</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">e</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> e.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'DiagnosticReport'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">dr</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    ngs.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">ngsid</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>e.fullUrl = <b>append</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'urn:uuid:'</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">ngsid</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;fullUrl&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    ngs<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>dr<b> then </b>MapNGSReport<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">ngs</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">dr</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;map&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;ngsReport&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">---------------------------------------------------------------------------</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">MapNGSReport: one DNPM NGS report → DiagnosticReport + child Observations</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">---------------------------------------------------------------------------</span>
<b>group </b>MapNGSReport<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">src</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>BackboneElement, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">tgt</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>DiagnosticReport, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Bundle<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">---- DiagnosticReport header ----</span>
  src.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">srcId</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.id = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">srcId</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'id'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;drId&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.status = <span style="color: blue">'final'</span> <i>&quot;drStatus&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Profile declaration</span>
  src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.meta<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">m</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>m.profile = <span style="color: blue">'https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/StructureDefinition/mii-pr-mtb-ngs-bericht'</span> <i>&quot;drProfile&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;drMeta&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Subject</span>
  src.patient<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">pat</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.subject<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">subj</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    pat.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">pid</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>subj.reference = <b>append</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'urn:uuid:'</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">pid</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;drSubjectRef&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;drSubject&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Specimen</span>
  src.specimen<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">spec</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.specimen<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">s</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    spec.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">sid</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>s.reference = <b>append</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'urn:uuid:'</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">sid</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;drSpecimenRef&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;drSpecimen&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Issued (date → instant)</span>
  src.issuedOn<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">d</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.issued = <b>append</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">d</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'T00:00:00Z'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;drIssued&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">---- NGS type → code ----</span>
  src.type<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">t</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">c</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    t<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>c.coding<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">coding</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      t.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">codeV</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.code = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">codeV</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;typeCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      t.system<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">systemV</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.system = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">systemV</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;typeSystem&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      t.display<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">displayV</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.display = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">displayV</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;typeDisplay&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;typeCoding&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;drCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">=========================================================================</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">TMB (Mutationslast)</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">=========================================================================</span>
  src.results<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">r</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>bundle<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    r.tmb<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">tmb</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">e</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> e.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Observation'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">obs</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      tmb.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">tmbid</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>e.fullUrl = <b>append</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'urn:uuid:'</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">tmbid</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;fullUrl&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      tmb<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>obs<b> then </b>MapTMB<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">tmb</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">obs</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;map&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;tmbEntry&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;tmbResults&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Reference from DiagnosticReport.result</span>
  src.results<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">r</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    r.tmb<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">tmb</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.result<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">res</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      tmb.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">tid</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>res.reference = <b>append</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'urn:uuid:'</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">tid</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;tmbResultRef&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;tmbResult&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;tmbResultsRef&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">=========================================================================</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">BRCAness</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">=========================================================================</span>
  src.results<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">r</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>bundle<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    r.brcaness<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">brca</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">e</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> e.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Observation'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">obs</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      brca.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">brcaid</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>e.fullUrl = <b>append</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'urn:uuid:'</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">brcaid</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;fullUrl&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      brca<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>obs<b> then </b>MapBRCAness<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">brca</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">obs</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;map&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;brcaEntry&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;brcaResults&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  src.results<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">r</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    r.brcaness<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">brca</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.result<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">res</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      brca.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">bid</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>res.reference = <b>append</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'urn:uuid:'</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bid</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;brcaResultRef&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;brcaResult&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;brcaResultsRef&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">=========================================================================</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">HRD Score</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">=========================================================================</span>
  src.results<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">r</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>bundle<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    r.hrdScore<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">hrd</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">e</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> e.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Observation'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">obs</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      hrd.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">hrdid</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>e.fullUrl = <b>append</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'urn:uuid:'</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">hrdid</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;fullUrl&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      hrd<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>obs<b> then </b>MapHRDScore<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">hrd</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">obs</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;map&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;hrdEntry&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;hrdResults&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  src.results<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">r</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    r.hrdScore<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">hrd</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.result<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">res</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      hrd.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">hid</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>res.reference = <b>append</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'urn:uuid:'</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">hid</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;hrdResultRef&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;hrdResult&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;hrdResultsRef&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">=========================================================================</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Simple Variants (SNVs / Indels)</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">=========================================================================</span>
  src.results<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">r</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>bundle<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    r.simpleVariants<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">sv</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">e</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> e.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Observation'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">obs</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      sv.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">svid</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>e.fullUrl = <b>append</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'urn:uuid:'</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">svid</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;fullUrl&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      sv<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>obs<b> then </b>MapSimpleVariant<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">sv</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">obs</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">src</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;map&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;svEntry&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;svResults&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  src.results<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">r</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    r.simpleVariants<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">sv</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.result<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">res</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      sv.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">svid</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>res.reference = <b>append</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'urn:uuid:'</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">svid</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;svResultRef&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;svResult&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;svResultsRef&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">=========================================================================</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Copy Number Variants</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">=========================================================================</span>
  src.results<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">r</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>bundle<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {

</span>    spec.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">sid</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>s.reference = <b>append</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'urn:uuid:'</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">sid</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;brcaSpecimenRef&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;brcaSpecimen&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">valueQuantity: BRCAness score</span>
  src.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">v</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.valueQuantity<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">vq</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    v<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>vq.value = <span style="color: maroon">v</span> <i>&quot;brcaVQValue&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>vq.unit = <span style="color: blue">'Score'</span> <i>&quot;brcaVQUnit&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>vq.system = <span style="color: blue">'http://unitsofmeasure.org'</span> <i>&quot;brcaVQSys&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>vq.code = <span style="color: blue">'1'</span> <i>&quot;brcaVQCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;brcaValueQuantity&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Confidence range → two components (min / max)</span>
  src.confidenceRange<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">cr</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.component<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">compMin</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>compMin.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">c</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>c.coding<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">coding</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.system = <span style="color: blue">'https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/CodeSystem/mii-cs-mtb-molekulare-biomarker'</span> <i>&quot;brcaMinCodeSys&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.code = <span style="color: blue">'brcaness-confidence-range-min'</span> <i>&quot;brcaMinCodeCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.display = <span style="color: blue">'BRCAness Confidence Range Minimum'</span> <i>&quot;brcaMinCodeDisplay&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;brcaMinCodeCoding&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;brcaMinCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    cr.min<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">minVal</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>compMin.valueQuantity<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">vq</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      minVal<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>vq.value = <span style="color: maroon">minVal</span> <i>&quot;brcaMinValue&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>vq.unit = <span style="color: blue">'Score'</span> <i>&quot;brcaMinUnit&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>vq.system = <span style="color: blue">'http://unitsofmeasure.org'</span> <i>&quot;brcaMinSys&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>vq.code = <span style="color: blue">'1'</span> <i>&quot;brcaMinCode2&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;brcaMinVQ&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;brcaConfMin&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  src.confidenceRange<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">cr</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.component<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">compMax</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>compMax.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">c</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>c.coding<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">coding</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.system = <span style="color: blue">'https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/CodeSystem/mii-cs-mtb-molekulare-biomarker'</span> <i>&quot;brcaMaxCodeSys&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.code = <span style="color: blue">'brcaness-confidence-range-max'</span> <i>&quot;brcaMaxCodeCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.display = <span style="color: blue">'BRCAness Confidence Range Maximum'</span> <i>&quot;brcaMaxCodeDisplay&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;brcaMaxCodeCoding&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;brcaMaxCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    cr.max<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">maxVal</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>compMax.valueQuantity<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">vq</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      maxVal<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>vq.value = <span style="color: maroon">maxVal</span> <i>&quot;brcaMaxValue&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>vq.unit = <span style="color: blue">'Score'</span> <i>&quot;brcaMaxUnit&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>vq.system = <span style="color: blue">'http://unitsofmeasure.org'</span> <i>&quot;brcaMaxSys&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>vq.code = <span style="color: blue">'1'</span> <i>&quot;brcaMaxCode2&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;brcaMaxVQ&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;brcaConfMax&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">---------------------------------------------------------------------------</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">MapHRDScore: DNPM hrdScore → MII_PR_MTB_HRD_Score (Observation)</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Profile code: $LNC#107286-7</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Components: LOH ($NCIT#C18016), TAI ($NCIT#C129774), LST ($NCIT#C120466)</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">---------------------------------------------------------------------------</span>
<b>group </b>MapHRDScore<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">src</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>BackboneElement, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">tgt</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Observation<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  src.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">srcId</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.id = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">srcId</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'id'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;hrdId&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.status = <span style="color: blue">'final'</span> <i>&quot;hrdStatus&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.meta<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">m</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>m.profile = <span style="color: blue">'https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/StructureDefinition/mii-pr-mtb-hrd-score'</span> <i>&quot;hrdProfile&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;hrdMeta&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Category: laboratory</span>
  src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.category<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">cat</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>cat.coding<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">coding</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.system = <span style="color: blue">'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/observation-category'</span> <i>&quot;hrdCatSys&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.code = <span style="color: blue">'laboratory'</span> <i>&quot;hrdCatCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;hrdCatCoding&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;hrdCategory&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Code: LOINC 107286-7</span>
  src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">c</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>c.coding<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">coding</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.system = <span style="color: blue">'http://loinc.org'</span> <i>&quot;hrdCodeSys&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.code = <span style="color: blue">'107286-7'</span> <i>&quot;hrdCodeCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.display = <span style="color: blue">'Homologous recombination deficiency status analysis [Presence] in Tissue by Molecular genetics method'</span> <i>&quot;hrdCodeDisplay&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;hrdCodeCoding&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;hrdCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Subject</span>
  src.patient<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">pat</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.subject<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">subj</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    pat.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">pid</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>subj.reference = <b>append</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'urn:uuid:'</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">pid</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;hrdSubjectRef&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;hrdSubject&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Specimen</span>
  src.specimen<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">spec</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.specimen<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">s</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    spec.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">sid</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>s.reference = <b>append</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'urn:uuid:'</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">sid</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;hrdSpecimenRef&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;hrdSpecimen&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">valueInteger: HRD composite score</span>
  src.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">v</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.valueInteger = <span style="color: maroon">v</span> <i>&quot;hrdValue&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Interpretation</span>
  src.interpretation<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">interp</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.interpretation<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">tgtInterp</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgtInterp.coding<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">c</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      interp.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">codeV</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>c.code = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">codeV</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;hrdInterpCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      interp.system<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">systemV</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>c.system = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">systemV</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;hrdInterpSys&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      interp.display<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">displayV</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>c.display = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">displayV</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;hrdInterpDisplay&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;hrdInterpCoding&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;hrdInterpretation&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Component: LOH ($NCIT#C18016)</span>
  src.components<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">comps</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    comps.loh<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">lohVal</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.component<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">comp</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>comp.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">c</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>c.coding<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">coding</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.system = <span style="color: blue">'http://ncicb.nci.nih.gov/xml/owl/EVS/Thesaurus.owl'</span> <i>&quot;hrdLohSys&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.code = <span style="color: blue">'C18016'</span> <i>&quot;hrdLohCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.display = <span style="color: blue">'Loss of Heterozygosity'</span> <i>&quot;hrdLohDisplay&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;hrdLohCodeCoding&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;hrdLohCode2&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      lohVal<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>comp.valueInteger = <span style="color: maroon">lohVal</span> <i>&quot;hrdLohValue&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;hrdLOHInner&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;hrdLOH&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Component: TAI ($NCIT#C129774)</span>
  src.components<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">comps</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    comps.tai<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">taiVal</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.component<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">comp</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>comp.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">c</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>c.coding<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">coding</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.system = <span style="color: blue">'http://ncicb.nci.nih.gov/xml/owl/EVS/Thesaurus.owl'</span> <i>&quot;hrdTaiSys&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.code = <span style="color: blue">'C129774'</span> <i>&quot;hrdTaiCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.display = <span style="color: blue">'Telomeric Allelic Imbalance Region'</span> <i>&quot;hrdTaiDisplay&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;hrdTaiCodeCoding&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;hrdTaiCode2&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      taiVal<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>comp.valueInteger = <span style="color: maroon">taiVal</span> <i>&quot;hrdTaiValue&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;hrdTAIInner&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;hrdTAI&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Component: LST ($NCIT#C120466)</span>
  src.components<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">comps</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    comps.lst<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">lstVal</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.component<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">comp</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>comp.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">c</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>c.coding<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">coding</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.system = <span style="color: blue">'http://ncicb.nci.nih.gov/xml/owl/EVS/Thesaurus.owl'</span> <i>&quot;hrdLstSys&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.code = <span style="color: blue">'C120466'</span> <i>&quot;hrdLstCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.display = <span style="color: blue">'Large-Scale State Transition'</span> <i>&quot;hrdLstDisplay&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;hrdLstCodeCoding&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

      lstVal<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>comp.valueInteger = <span style="color: maroon">lstVal</span> <i>&quot;hrdLstValue&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;hrdLSTInner&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">---------------------------------------------------------------------------</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">MapSimpleVariant: DNPM simpleVariants[*] → MII_PR_MTB_Einfache_Variante</span>

</span>        pos5<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>vr.low<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">low</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {

        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf5PosLow&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        pos5<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>vr.high<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">high</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          pos5<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>high.value = <span style="color: maroon">pos5</span> <i>&quot;rf5PosHighValue&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf5PosHigh&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf5PosRange&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf5PrimePositionInner&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf5PrimePosition&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">component[five-prime-strand]</span>
  src.fusionPartner5prime<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">fp5</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    fp5.strand<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">strand5</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.component<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">comp</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>comp.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">c</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>c.coding<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">coding</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.system = <span style="color: blue">'https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/CodeSystem/mii-cs-mtb-molekulare-biomarker'</span> <i>&quot;rf5SCodeSys&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.code = <span style="color: blue">'five-prime-strand'</span> <i>&quot;rf5SCodeCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.display = <span style="color: blue">'Five Prime Strand'</span> <i>&quot;rf5SCodeDisplay&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf5SCodeCoding&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf5SCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      strand5<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>comp.valueCodeableConcept<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">vc</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>vc.text = <span style="color: maroon">strand5</span> <i>&quot;rf5StrandText&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf5StrandVCC&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf5PrimeStrandInner&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf5PrimeStrand&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">---- 3' fusion partner ----</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">component[three-prime-gene]</span>
  src.fusionPartner3prime<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">fp3</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    fp3.gene<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">gene3</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.component<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">comp</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>comp.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">c</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>c.coding<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">coding</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.system = <span style="color: blue">'https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/CodeSystem/mii-cs-mtb-molekulare-biomarker'</span> <i>&quot;rf3GCodeSys&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.code = <span style="color: blue">'three-prime-gene'</span> <i>&quot;rf3GCodeCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.display = <span style="color: blue">'Three Prime Gene'</span> <i>&quot;rf3GCodeDisplay&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf3GCodeCoding&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf3GCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      gene3<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>comp.valueCodeableConcept<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">vc</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>vc.coding<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">c</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          gene3.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">codeV</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>c.code = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">codeV</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;rf3GVCCCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          gene3.system<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">systemV</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>c.system = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">systemV</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;rf3GVCCSys&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          gene3.display<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">displayV</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>c.display = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">displayV</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;rf3GVCCDisplay&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf3GVCCCoding&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf3GVCC&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf3PrimeGeneInner&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf3PrimeGene&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">component[three-prime-transcript-id]</span>
  src.fusionPartner3prime<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">fp3</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    fp3.transcript<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">t3</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.component<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">comp</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>comp.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">c</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>c.coding<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">coding</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.system = <span style="color: blue">'https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/CodeSystem/mii-cs-mtb-molekulare-biomarker'</span> <i>&quot;rf3TCodeSys&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.code = <span style="color: blue">'three-prime-transcript-id'</span> <i>&quot;rf3TCodeCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.display = <span style="color: blue">'Three Prime Transcript ID'</span> <i>&quot;rf3TCodeDisplay&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf3TCodeCoding&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf3TCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      t3<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>comp.valueCodeableConcept<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">vc</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>vc.coding<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">c</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          t3.value<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">valueV</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>c.code = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">valueV</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;rf3TVCCCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          t3.system<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">systemV</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>c.system = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">systemV</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;rf3TVCCSys&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf3TVCCCoding&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf3TVCC&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf3PrimeTranscriptInner&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf3PrimeTranscript&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">component[three-prime-exon-id]</span>
  src.fusionPartner3prime<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">fp3</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    fp3.exon<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">exon3</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.component<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">comp</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>comp.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">c</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>c.coding<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">coding</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.system = <span style="color: blue">'https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/CodeSystem/mii-cs-mtb-molekulare-biomarker'</span> <i>&quot;rf3ECodeSys&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.code = <span style="color: blue">'three-prime-exon-id'</span> <i>&quot;rf3ECodeCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.display = <span style="color: blue">'Three Prime Exon ID'</span> <i>&quot;rf3ECodeDisplay&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf3ECodeCoding&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf3ECode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      exon3<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>comp.valueCodeableConcept<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">vc</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>vc.text = <span style="color: maroon">exon3</span> <i>&quot;rf3ExonText&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf3EVCC&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf3PrimeExonInner&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf3PrimeExon&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">component[three-prime-position]</span>
  src.fusionPartner3prime<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">fp3</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    fp3.position<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">pos3</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.component<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">comp</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>comp.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">c</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>c.coding<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">coding</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.system = <span style="color: blue">'https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/CodeSystem/mii-cs-mtb-molekulare-biomarker'</span> <i>&quot;rf3PCodeSys&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.code = <span style="color: blue">'three-prime-position'</span> <i>&quot;rf3PCodeCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.display = <span style="color: blue">'Three Prime Position'</span> <i>&quot;rf3PCodeDisplay&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf3PCodeCoding&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf3PCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      pos3<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>comp.valueRange<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">vr</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        pos3<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>vr.low<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">low</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          pos3<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>low.value = <span style="color: maroon">pos3</span> <i>&quot;rf3PosLowValue&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf3PosLow&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        pos3<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>vr.high<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">high</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          pos3<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>high.value = <span style="color: maroon">pos3</span> <i>&quot;rf3PosHighValue&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf3PosHigh&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf3PosRange&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf3PrimePositionInner&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf3PrimePosition&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">component[three-prime-strand]</span>
  src.fusionPartner3prime<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">fp3</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt<b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    fp3.strand<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">strand3</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.component<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">comp</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>comp.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">c</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>c.coding<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">coding</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.system = <span style="color: blue">'https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-mtb/CodeSystem/mii-cs-mtb-molekulare-biomarker'</span> <i>&quot;rf3SCodeSys&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.code = <span style="color: blue">'three-prime-strand'</span> <i>&quot;rf3SCodeCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.display = <span style="color: blue">'Three Prime Strand'</span> <i>&quot;rf3SCodeDisplay&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf3SCodeCoding&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf3SCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      strand3<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>comp.valueCodeableConcept<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">vc</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>vc.text = <span style="color: maroon">strand3</span> <i>&quot;rf3StrandText&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf3StrandVCC&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf3PrimeStrandInner&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rf3PrimeStrand&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">component[allelic-read-depth]: LOINC 82121-5 (reportedNumReads)</span>
  src.reportedNumReads<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">reads</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.component<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">comp</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>comp.code<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">c</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>c.coding<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">coding</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.system = <span style="color: blue">'http://loinc.org'</span> <i>&quot;rfRdCodeSys&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.code = <span style="color: blue">'82121-5'</span> <i>&quot;rfRdCodeCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.display = <span style="color: blue">'Allelic read depth'</span> <i>&quot;rfRdCodeDisplay&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rfRdCodeCoding&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rfRdCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    reads<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>comp.valueQuantity<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">vq</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      reads<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>vq.value = <span style="color: maroon">reads</span> <i>&quot;rfRdValue&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>vq.system = <span style="color: blue">'http://unitsofmeasure.org'</span> <i>&quot;rfRdSys&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      src<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>vq.code = <span style="color: blue">'1'</span> <i>&quot;rfRdUCUM&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rfRdVQ&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;rfReads&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span></pre></div>
